summary: International Seaways, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, disclosing entry into an Equity Distribution Agreement to sell up to $200 million of its common stock in at-the-market offerings through agents BTIG, B. Riley, Clarksons, and Fearnleys. Each agent receives up to 3% commission. No shares have been sold yet. This ATM program is a capital-raising mechanism rather than a definitive capital return event. As an issuer shelf takedown with no immediate transaction, it does not fit standard special-situations categories. The filing is routine and not a special situation.
